# Activat VC

> Activat VC is a venture company (since 2014) that invests in early-stage IT startups at pre-seed and seed. Own check is usually up to USD 100,000; larger rounds are syndicated with members of the Activat Invest club and other investors. Applications are accepted only through the form at https://apply.activat.vc/ and must be submitted by the founder personally.

## How to apply

- Application form: https://apply.activat.vc/
- Founders page (criteria, what to prepare, selection steps, FAQ): https://activat.vc/startups; questions — AI assistant on the site
- Investment declaration (mandate): https://activat.vc/declaration
- The founder fills in and submits the form personally and gives the data-processing consents. An AI assistant may help prepare the materials. Applications or emails sent by an agent on the founder's behalf are not considered.

## Mandate

- Stage: pre-seed, seed.
- Founders: at least one founder from Kazakhstan, Central Asia or the Caucasus. Details: https://activat.vc/declaration
- Sectors: technology products in any industry except blockchain and crypto, DeepTech, gambling.
- Exit horizon: up to 3 years or 2 rounds.

## Minimum requirements

- Global market of at least USD 10 billion.
- Prototype or MVP.
- Traction: sales, deals, revenue, users or downloads.
- Roadmap to the next round and a financial model for 12–18 months.

## What to prepare

- Pitch deck (PDF), financial model (Excel), link to a founder video pitch, founders and cap table, traction data, round size and use of funds.

## Process (2–3 weeks on average)

1. Application at apply.activat.vc
2. Call or meeting with the Activat VC team
3. Preliminary investment committee
4. Due diligence
5. Final investment committee and answer to the founder
6. Term sheet, signing, investment

## Other audiences

- Investors (co-investment, Activat Invest club): https://activat.vc/invest
- Venture scouts: https://activat.vc/scout
- Careers: https://activat.vc/karera

# Activat VC (кратко по-русски)

Activat VC инвестирует в IT-стартапы на стадиях pre-seed и seed, собственный чек обычно до 100 000 долларов США. Заявка — только через форму https://apply.activat.vc/, подаёт её сам основатель. Подробно для основателей: https://activat.vc/startups
